name: Non-destructive testing (UT, PAUT, radiography, eddy current)
aliases: Non-destructive testing (UT, PAUT, radiography, eddy current)
principle: NDT evaluates a component without damaging it. Ultrasonic testing reflects sound off flaws; phased array adds beam steering; radiography uses penetrating radiation; eddy current tests surfaces and welds.

process_steps.name: Apply UT, PAUT, RT or ECT
